description: MUSIC for the edit. action "compose" (default): the local music engine composes and mixes an original track (no samples, no internet, free to use) exactly as long as the edit, with drops on given timeline seconds (default "auto": markers named drop/hit, else the end of the hook and a cut around 60 %) and a final hit at the end; style pop|trap|house|lofi|synthwave|cinematic, mood, key ("Am", "C"), bpm, seed (same seed = same track; new seed = new variation), stems:true for WAV stems. Sets options.music with an exact beat grid (beat_sync then snaps to the real beats). dryRun returns tempo map + sections without rendering. "use" {file}: your own audio file (also downloads from Suno/Udio etc.). "elevenlabs" {prompt?}: online generation with the user's own ElevenLabs key (only the prompt is sent). "styles": styles, moods, providers. "provider" {provider:"elevenlabs", apiKey}: save a key locally (never returned).
name: studio_music
